messages:
Zoe: Opening a tiny docs PR for a sealed-site preflight + HSM mapping checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4377. Asking eng-runtime + security for a quick sanity pass.
Marcus: 👍 Can you include the exact preflight commands we tell customers to run (connectivity, CA bundle, pkcs11 checks)? Ops copies these straight into runbooks.
Zoe: Drafting those now. Will add an example mapping file and a short troubleshooting table for common failures (auth loop, missing slot).
Zoe: Preflight snippets (paste into support ticket):
```bash
# control-plane reachability (from sealed host)
curl -sSf --retry 3 --connect-timeout 5 https://{{ REDWOOD_API_URL }}/v1/health || echo "control plane unreachable"
# check TLS trust (simple):
openssl s_client -connect $(echo $REDWOOD_API_HOST):443 -CAfile /etc/redwood/ca.pem -brief
# list PKCS#11 slots (requires pkcs11-tool)
pkcs11-tool --list-slots --module /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so
```
Chen: For the mapping example, suggest a small YAML that maps logical keys to slots so they remain consistent across restores.
Zoe: Added YAML example:```yaml
# hsm_slot_map.yml (example)
keys:
  - name: redwood-root
    slot: 1
    label: RW_ROOT_KEY
  - name: tenant-a-signing
    slot: 2
    label: TENANT_A
```
Marcus: Include a note about deterministic slot assignment: some HSMs renumber slots after firmware update. Recommend also storing token serial and label and fallback to label match.
Zoe: Good call — added paragraph: "Prefer label+serial fallback; do not rely on slot index alone."
docs-bot: Linkcheck: /private/sealedsite#preflight -> 404 (suggested anchor /private/sealedsite#preflight-checks). Ran at 2026-03-22T13:40Z.
QA-bot: Quick QA checklist added: verify `sha256sum`, check system clock (NTP), confirm pkcs11-tool lists the expected label, confirm /etc/redwood/ca.pem exists.
Chen: Tiny extra: show the `gpg --list-keys` example we use for offline bundles. Ops team asked for that repeatedly.
Zoe: Added `gpg --no-default-keyring --keyring /etc/redwood/keys/redwood-kb.kbx --list-keys` snippet and a one-liner to check signature: `gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz`.
Marcus: LGTM after the anchor fix and a small wording tweak on the slot fallback sentence. I'll approve in the PR. :thumbsup:
Zoe: Thanks — will fix the anchor and merge once Marcus approves. Will post a short note in #eng-docs describing the new preflight commands.
